pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal to diamond-shaped dark regions with smooth edge gradients and low angularity; patches on the upper flank are higher in contrast than those on the lower posterior region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of narrow light pathways forming a topological graph with frequent tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the neck ridge, appearing as a short, uniform mane against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark-colored oxpecker (Buphagus) is perched on the dorsal mane near the shoulder region.
